summary: Don't go into the woods during the new season! Structured changes across 17 entities this patch.

champions.name: Akshan
champions.tldr: New Effect: Now lasts indefinitely while affected by Chemtech Fog.; Tooltip now states that the bonuses while moving towards Scoundrels is only granted during Going Rogue.
champions.gameplayImpact: Akshan is stronger on paper. Expect a higher presence until the meta adapts; good time to learn or re-pick them.
